Visitor replaces line break with custom output

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        class _TestVisitor implements HtmlVisitor {
            @Override public VisitResult visitLineBreak(NodeContext ctx) {
                return new VisitResult.Custom(" | ");
            }
        }
        var visitor = new _TestVisitor();
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<p>First line<br>Second line<br>Third line</p>", ConversionOptions.builder().withVisitor(visitor).build());
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
```
